# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Restored the plant happy-path regression to require actual biomass growth again, and validated the current 3.0 g/1000 cm² startup plant density against shipped scenario footprints. On the scenario/materialization side, reintroduced default filter biomedia area scaling with tank footprint so seeded tanks no longer all inherit the same 2000 cm² filter habitat, while also adding explicit `filter_media_area_cm2` override support to both `ScenarioPreset` and `StartupOverrides` plus validation for authored values. Added regressions covering default biomedia scaling, scenario-authored biomedia overrides, startup override precedence, and scenario-footprint plant biomass initialization.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current scenario materialization, startup override, and end-to-end plant-growth paths to verify which pending amendments were still unresolved versus already fixed in-tree.
2. [Completed] Patched scenario/startup materialization so filter media area scales with geometry by default, added explicit scenario/startup media-area override plumbing plus validation, and restored the strict happy-path plant growth assertion.
3. [Completed] Added regression coverage for scenario-footprint plant biomass, default and authored filter-media materialization behavior, formatted the code, and reran the affected scenario and end-to-end suites.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios` passed, including the new `initial_plant_biomass_matches_scenario_footprint_density`, `default_filter_media_area_scales_with_scenario_footprint`, `startup_overrides_can_override_filter_media_area`, and `materialize_scenario_honors_authored_filter_media_area` regressions.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test end_to_end` passed (17 tests), including the restored strict `happy_plants_grow_with_light_and_nutrients` assertion.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation covered `tank_scenarios` and `tank_core` end-to-end regressions, not the full workspace test suite.
- Default filter biomedia scaling now uses footprint-relative starter hardware as a heuristic; shipped scenarios still rely on that default until authors provide hardware-specific `filter_media_area_cm2` values where needed.
- The worktree still contains unrelated local modifications/untracked files outside this change, which were intentionally left untouched.
